+def _jobs(data):
+    jobs = data["jobs"]
+    blocked = set(data.get("blocked", []))
+    mandatory = set(data.get("mandatory", []))
+    quotas = data.get("quotas", {})
+    k = data["k"]
+    best_value = None
+    best_ids = None
+
+    available = [job for job in jobs if job["id"] not in blocked]
+    for subset in product((False, True), repeat=len(available)):
+        chosen = [job for job, take in zip(available, subset) if take]
+        if len(chosen) != k:
+            continue
+        ids = sorted(job["id"] for job in chosen)
+        if not mandatory.issubset(ids):
+            continue
+        counts = {}
+        for job in chosen:
+            counts[job["group"]] = counts.get(job["group"], 0) + 1
+        if any(not low <= counts.get(group, 0) <= high
+               for group, (low, high) in quotas.items()):
+            continue
+        ordered = sorted(chosen, key=lambda job: (job["start"], job["end"]))
+        if any(ordered[i]["start"] < ordered[i - 1]["end"]
+               for i in range(1, len(ordered))):
+            continue
+        value = sum(job["value"] for job in chosen)
+        if (best_value is None or value > best_value or
+                (value == best_value and ids > best_ids)):
+            best_value, best_ids = value, ids
+
+    if best_value is None:
+        return {"error": "impossible"}
+    return {"selected": best_ids, "value": best_value}
